plugins.name: paysera-payments
plugins.description: Create (draft) or cancel/delete a Paysera payment/transfer via the public Transfer API using a scoped Personal Access Token — the "do a payment / pay this invoice" action. Use when asked to create, cancel, or delete a payment, transfer, pavedimas, or mokėjimas on a configured Paysera account. Create is drafts-only — it does NOT sign/execute; signing happens in the Paysera app (2FA). Cancel/delete removes a live (unsigned) draft. Keywords — payment, transfer, pavedimas, mokėjimas, SEPA, invoice. Do NOT use for — diagnosing why an existing payment failed or is stuck, or handling a support ticket about one; contact Paysera support instead.
